note: Instance 01. Thresholds are national scales; owners are municipal roles; the geography is measured for this corporation.

hazards.trigger: Forecast or observation of 64.5 to 115.5 mm in 24 hours
hazards.starts: Desilting crews and pumps moved to the listed flood-prone spots; lake gate watch opened
hazards.window: On forecast, and through the monsoon from 15 May
hazards.where: Flood-prone spots listed by the corporation

hazards.trigger: Above 115.5 mm in 24 hours, or a nowcast of the same
hazards.starts: Relief centres opened in wards with a flood record; pumps pre-positioned; underpass diversions
hazards.owner: Zonal Commissioner with the district authority
hazards.window: Within six hours of the forecast
hazards.where: Wards with a recorded flood history

hazards.trigger: A tank at or above 90 per cent of full tank level with rain forecast
hazards.starts: Pre-emptive drawdown; alert to the ground below the tank; lake path closed
hazards.where: Tanks and the ground below them

hazards.trigger: Maximum at or above 40 C, or 4.5 C above normal
hazards.scale: IMD heat-wave criterion for the plains
hazards.starts: Water kiosks opened; park and lake hours extended; outdoor work rescheduled
hazards.owner: Health Officer with the Zonal Commissioner
hazards.window: On declaration, and for the spell
hazards.where: Wards with the least canopy and the most outdoor work

measured.label: Ground that took water in 2017 and does not now
